record.question: Antigen typing on red cells should not be performed if patients had previous transfusion within the past:
record.explanation: Answer C: 3 month. Recent donor red cells can persist and confound serologic antigen phenotyping; a three-month post-transfusion window is used in transfusion guidance, with genotyping considered when recently transfused. Source/context note: Phrase this as serologic RBC antigen phenotyping for transfusion work; molecular genotyping is not subject to donor-cell admixture in the same way. Reference: https://www.transfusionguidelines.org/red-book/chapter-13-patient-testing-red-cell-immunohaematology.pdf; https://www.transfusionguidelines.org/document-library/documents/rci-and-panels-pdf/download-file/RCI%20and%20Panels.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
